items.title: Ralph LaLama interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, May 23, 2010
items.q: Ralph has co-led a quartet with fellow saxophonist Joe Lovano

ctx.x: Well that’s it: Lovano, LaLama, you know, Nistico. Even Zito or a’s.
Very interesting. A couple of books have come out recently about that. Italian Americans in the jazz world.
